working_definition: Nuclei of the authors' 'Adipose tissue' cluster(s) (Saavedra et al. 2023, Figure 3a), dissected adult male thoraces, control genotype.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Fat cell of the adult fat body. These cells are derived from cells of the larval body wall and adepithelial cells associated with imaginal discs (Hoshizaki et al., 1995; Musselman and Kuhnlein, 2018). Fully-differentiated adult fat cells are found from around 3-4 days after eclosion (Aguila et al., 2007). Unlike the larval fat cells, they are diploid (Musselman and Kuhnlein, 2018).

justification: The authors' annotation 'Adipose tissue' (Fly Cell Atlas-based). The adipose tissue (fat body): its cell type, the fat cell.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00049949 adult fat cell (exact match).
